choices: A name pointing at a commit, without extra tag object metadata
A branch that auto-updates on every push
Only stored on GitHub, never locally
items.explain: Lightweight tags are simple refs to a commit; annotated tags add message, tagger, and date.

items.prompt: For a published release you share with others, prefer…
items.explain: Annotated tags carry release metadata and are the usual choice for semver releases.

items.prompt: git push alone always pushes all local tags to the remote.
items.explain: Tags are not pushed by default; use git push origin --tags or push a specific tag name.

items.prompt: git show v1.0 is useful to…
choices: Inspect which commit a tag points to (and annotation if present)
items.explain: git show on a tag reveals the tagged commit and, for annotated tags, the tag message.
